card.name: Partway through dosing and file-permission strings
card.fires_on: Responds partway through a word or string that is about to be completed, such as pr-n, Inf-use, tit-rate, intr-avenous, and Unix permission strings like drwxr-xr-x. It also fires on a few instruction verbs like Take.

modes.label: Dosing words mid-spelling
modes.description: Partway through route or action words in dosage instructions, such as intravenous, infuse, titrate.

modes.label: Unix permission strings
modes.description: Inside file mode strings like drwxr-xr-x or brw-r----- in directory listings.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of a half-written word, mostly dosing words like intravenous or titrate, and also in computer file-permission codes.
